purpose_context: felix-deployer is supposed to silently reset the office2 security baselines after any deploy that changes an audited surface, so the daily security audit never fires a false drift alert and the operator never has to rebaseline by hand. Issue #685 shows that automation silently skips when the code checkout was advanced out-of-band before the deploy tick, and when a deploy mutates state through a CLI with no repo-file trace (e.g. removing an OpenClaw cron). This mission closes both gaps so the 'no operator action' guarantee actually holds.
purpose_tldr: Make felix-deployer's auto-rebaseline fire reliably after every deploy, so there are no false security-drift alerts and no manual rebaselining.
